overview: The Driftwood Spars is an inn with 15 en-suite rooms at Trevaunance Cove, just below St Agnes village, with its own brewery, two bars and a sea-view restaurant. It sits a short walk from the cove and the South West Coast Path. Note it is in St Agnes, not Perranporth.
surfTripFit: Trevaunance Cove is on the doorstep and parking is plentiful, making it handy for St Agnes surf and a short drive to Perranporth or Porthtowan.
gaps: Board storage not stated; room count from tourism board, not own site. Location is St Agnes - area tag 'perranporth' may need changing.
